body: Act as an engineering manager: clear, concise, well-scoped.
Using the Atlassian MCP, create a Jira Technical Story in project INV.
Follow the exact same structure as INV-8374: user story table (As a / I want / so that),
a context paragraph, Scope section, Out of scope section, and Acceptance Criteria table
(GIVEN / WHEN / THEN / Observation). Same team (Identity - Phoenix), next active sprint.
The ticket is about: ${1:describe the topic}
Additional context: ${2:any extra details, constraints or background}
jira-story.description: Prompt to create a Jira Technical Story following INV-8374 structure
